focusedAudit.reason: A Beta release; no exact-tree release audit was run for this Beta; explicit deferral, not certification.

items.text: **A query export no longer publishes pages marked `public:: false`**, as every other export already did: when the query matches such a page, the page, its results and its share of the result count stay out of the export, and the review lists only the pages that are exported. A query that matches only such pages is refused (REG-QUERY-EXPORT-PRIVATE-PAGES).

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: REG-QUERY-EXPORT-PRIVATE-PAGES (fail-before proven on release/0.8: the plan exported ["Org private","Private","Public"]; a mutation check showed the result rows still leaked without the og 6878bbcd4 part). Store-integration tests; no native journey.

docs.reason: The Guide and the export dialog (en, zh-CN) said a query export ignores public::; corrected in 27ae6d73f and asserted in crates/tine-core/src/guide.rs.

items.text: A page marked `template::` in its own property header (the lines at the top of the page, before the first bullet, or an Org page's `#+TEMPLATE:` line or head drawer) is now listed as a template, as in Logseq: `/` shows it as **Template: Name** and typing `/template` lists it with the others, and choosing it inserts the page's property lines as one block, without the `template::` line and with `<% today %>` and the like filled in. Before, only a `template::` on a block counted, so a page that Logseq listed as a template was missing from Tine (discussion #729, UI-GH729-PAGE-PROPERTY-TEMPLATE). The template is the property header only, not the page's blocks below it; `template-including-parent:: false` on a header therefore inserts nothing. Ctrl+K never listed templates in Logseq either.

regressionEvidence.reason: Catalog coverage: UI-GH729-PAGE-PROPERTY-TEMPLATE. Unit fail-before: with the fix disabled only 1 of 6 templates is listed; the native journey scripts/e2e-gh729-page-template.mjs fails on the beta.6 binary and passed 3/3 on the branch and in the release/0.8 integration gate (Linux).

docs.reason: The Guide says a page can be a template through its own property header; asserted in src/guideGh729.test.ts.
